ja: 「歴代のＴＶシリーズガンダムがガンプラで勢揃い！ガンダム３０周年記念アイテム決定版！」
歴代のＴＶガンダムシリーズを代表するガンダムがコレクションできる
機動戦士ガンダム３０周年記念キット・１２体セット（１／１４４＆ＨＧ１／１４４）。
キットはガンプラの特殊加工としては珍しいラメ入りクリア成形。
数々の思い出が甦る小冊子付属。
シリアルナンバー入りのプレミアムＢＯＸに入れてお届け予定。

en: "All the Gundam TV series are available at Gunpla! The definitive Gundam 30th anniversary commemorative item!"
You can collect Gundam s that represent the successive TV Gundam series.
Mobile Suit Gundam 30th Anniversary Kit, 12 pieces set (1/144 & HG 1/144).
Kit is clear molded with glitter, which is rare among Gunpla's special processing.
Comes with a booklet that will bring back many memories.
Scheduled delivery in a premium box with serial number.
[Set contents]
●Assembly type plastic model Clear molding kit with glitter 12 pieces
・1/144 Gundam
・HG 1/144 Gundam Ver. G30th
・1/144 Z Gundam
・1/144 ZZ Gundam
・1/144 V Gundam
・1/144 G Gundam
・1/144 W Gundam
・1/144 Gundam X
・1/144 ∀Gundam
・1/144 Freedom Gundam
・1/144 Destiny Gundam
・HG 1/144 00 Gundam
●AssemblyManual and Seal corresponding to each kit are included.
●The package is a set box with a serial number (inside is a sleeve for each kit).
●Original booklet included.
**Some kits use plastic model adhesive for assembly (sold separately)
*Specifications are scheduled as of late October. Please note that there may be slight changes.
*Images are prototypes (including image images). The actual product may differ slightly from the actual product.
*There is a limited number of reservations available for sale at this time. Applications will be closed before the indicated application deadline.
Alternatively, we may change the delivery schedule.
